user.title: Configure room
user.description: One primary sensor is enough; additional sensors are optional. Primary: only the primary sensor starts occupancy; additional sensors hold it. Equal: any sensor may start occupancy.

data_description.volume_reset: Optional. Changes the next visit’s fade target, not ongoing playback.
data_description.volume_cooldown: Starts when the room clears after the clear delay. Returning within this time keeps the last volume; the full cooldown starts again on the next departure.
data_description.tv_volume_offset: Added to the volume selected on entry: remembered volume, or default volume after an enabled cooldown has expired. Also works with volume reset disabled. 30% - 10% = 20%. 0 disables the adjustment. Music/AirPlay are unchanged.
data_description.secondary: Leave empty to use only the primary sensor. Existing additional sensors can be removed here.

error.distinct_sensors: The primary sensor cannot also be selected as an additional sensor.
error.invalid_sources: Choose at least one different Sonos speaker as source.
error.player_used: This speaker is already managed by another room.
